info.name: School Grading API
info.description:
Tests for the School Grading ASP.NET Core Web API.

1. Select an environment (**School Grading - Local** or **- Azure**).
2. Run the whole collection (Run collection) - the folders are in order.
Login requests save JWT tokens into collection variables automatically.
The collection puts the data back the way it was (deletes the student it adds, unpublishes 9-A).

item.name: 1. Auth - Login
item.description: Log in as each role and keep their JWT tokens for the next requests.

request.description: Logs in as admin@school.com and saves the JWT into the collection variable **adminToken**.
Logs in as vp@school.com and saves the JWT into the collection variable **vpToken**.

exec: pm.test("Sania is Class Teacher of Class 8 - B", () => pm.expect(json.user.classTeacherOfClassName).to.eql("Class 8 - B"));

request.description: Logs in as sania@school.com and saves the JWT into the collection variable **saniaToken**.
Logs in as maryam@school.com and saves the JWT into the collection variable **maryamToken**.

exec: pm.test("Error message mentions \"Invalid Login ID or password\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Invalid Login ID or password"));

request.description: Error case: wrong password returns 401 with a JSON message (same message for an unknown Login ID).

item.name: 2. Auth - Create account & first login
item.description: Admin creates an account (registration). The new user must change the temporary password before using the app.

request.description: Admin creates a Teacher. The server generates the Login ID and a temporary password (shown once).

item.name: Register - class already has a Class Teacher

exec: pm.test("Error message mentions \"already has a Class Teacher\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("already has a Class Teacher"));
pm.test("Error message mentions \"Only the Admin\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Only the Admin"));

request.description: No Authorization header -> 401 from the JWT middleware.

item.name: Login - new Teacher with temporary password
New Teacher - blocked until password is changed

exec: pm.test("Error message mentions \"change your temporary password\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("change your temporary password"));
pm.test("Error message mentions \"one letter and one number\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("one letter and one number"));
pm.test("Error message mentions \"Current password is incorrect\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Current password is incorrect"));
pm.test("Must change password is now false", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().mustChangePassword).to.be.false);

item.name: 3. Users & password reset (Admin)
item.description: Only the Admin can list users and reset forgotten passwords.

exec: pm.test("No password hashes in the response", () => users.forEach(u => pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property("passwordHash")));
pm.test("New Teacher is in the list", () => pm.expect(me).to.not.be.undefined);

item.name: Reset password - Admin resets the new Teacher

exec: pm.test("A new temporary password is returned", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().temporaryPassword).to.have.lengthOf(10));

item.name: Login - old password stops working after reset
4. Classes, tracker & students
item.description: School overview, the Class Teacher's live tracker, and student management.

exec: pm.test("Each subject shows its teacher and progress", () => t.subjects.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.teacherName).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(s.enteredCount).to.be.at.most(s.studentCount); }));
pm.test("Error message mentions \"Only the Class Teacher\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Only the Class Teacher"));
pm.test("Error message mentions \"Still waiting for\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Still waiting for"));
pm.test("Roll number is padded to 06", () => pm.expect(s.rollNo).to.eql("06"));

item.name: Tracker 8-B - submissions cleared after adding a student

exec: pm.test("No subject is \"submitted\" any more", () => pm.response.json().subjects.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.submittedAt).to.be.null));

item.name: 5. Marks upload & update
item.description: Subject teachers upload marks (draft or submit). Rules: 0..max, all students before submit.

item.name: Submit marks - one student still empty

exec: // Builds the request body from the students saved by 'Marks of 8-B Chemistry'
const marks = rows.map((r, i) => ({ studentId: r.studentId, obtained: i === rows.length - 1 ? null : 40 }));
pm.collectionVariables.set("marksBody", JSON.stringify({ marks: marks, submit: true }, null, 2));
// Builds the request body from the students saved by 'Marks of 8-B Chemistry'
const marks = rows.map(r => ({ studentId: r.studentId, obtained: 40 }));
pm.collectionVariables.set("marksBody", JSON.stringify({ marks: marks, submit: true }, null, 2));
pm.test("Error message mentions \"not assigned to you\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("not assigned to you"));

item.name: 6. Result cards & delete student
item.description: Report cards (Class Teacher, VP, Admin) and deleting a student.

exec: pm.test("Complete card has a percentage and a grade", () => { pm.expect(card.isComplete).to.be.true; pm.expect(card.grade).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Incomplete card has no grade yet", () => { pm.expect(card.isComplete).to.be.false; pm.expect(card.grade).to.be.null; });

Delete student - the one added earlier
